invariants: Trace values are observed or null with a reason; no metric is estimated or inferred from text length.
No secret value from the environment or a known key pattern is ever written to a trace file.
Traces are evidence only; neither the trace writer nor the report decides acceptance or value.
A trace file whose content no longer matches its digest chain is rejected.
Observing a run never changes its outcome: with invocationObserver null the BB-097 supervisor behaves byte-identically.
architectureDecisions: D1 — AGENT_TOOL_RUN_TRACE_V1 = { kind, version, traceId, sequence, prevDigest, digest, runId, taskId, tool, toolVersion, arm (caller-supplied label, opaque), mode (DIRECT|SUPERVISED), attemptIndex, startedAt, endedAt (wall clock taken around the invocation), durationMs (runner value), status (COMPLETED|TIMED_OUT|TOOL_UNAVAILABLE), exitCode, signal, timedOut, promptSha256, argvRedacted, stdout/stderr: { sha256 (runner full-stream digest), capturedBytes, truncated, excerpt }, logFile: { sha256, bytes, excerpt } | null, toolEvents: { counts by type, invalidLines } | null, usage: { inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens, source, unavailableReason }, diff: { filesChanged, insertions, deletions, binaryFiles }, verification: [{ name, status, reason }], harness: { events: [{ type, capability, scope }], spans: [{ kind, name, status, durationMs, scope }] } | null }. argv elements equal to the prompt are replaced by `<prompt sha256=… chars=N>`; excerpts keep at most the last 4000 characters of the redacted text.

D2 — createRunTraceWriter({ dir }) appends one JSON line per trace to <dir>/traces.jsonl with sequence = previous + 1. digest = sha256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys) of the record without digest, and prevDigest = the previous line digest (null for the first). verifyTraceFile(path) recomputes every digest, sequence and prevDigest link and throws an error with code TRACE_CHAIN_BROKEN on any edit, deletion, insertion or reorder; readTraces(dir) returns verified records.

D3 — Direct runs: runObservedInvocation({ tool, request, cwd, env, timeoutMs, maxOutputBytes, baseRevision, taskId, arm, attemptIndex, toolVersion, writer, verification = [] }) takes startedAt/endedAt around BB-097 runAgentInvocation, then builds and appends the trace with harness null. Diff = `git diff --numstat <baseRevision>` of the working tree plus untracked files from `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` (each untracked text file counts as one file with insertions = its line count; binary numstat `-` counts in binaryFiles with null line counts). It reads nothing outside cwd and the invocation logFile, and writes nothing into cwd.

D4 — Parsers: parseCodexJsonl(stdout) counts events by `type` and sums usage only over `turn.completed` events whose `usage` has numeric input_tokens and output_tokens (cached_input_tokens and reasoning_output_tokens summed when numeric, else null); with no such event every token field is null and unavailableReason is CODEX_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED. A non-JSON line or a line without string `type` increments invalidLines and never aborts parsing; when stdout was truncated the reason is CODEX_STREAM_TRUNCATED unless usage was found. Kiro: toolEvents null, usage null, KIRO_TEXT_OUTPUT_NO_USAGE. agy: the --log-file is stored only as { sha256, bytes, excerpt }; usage null, AGY_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED. TOOL_UNAVAILABLE and TIMED_OUT runs carry usage null with TOOL_UNAVAILABLE or TIMED_OUT.

D5 — Supervised runs: BB-097 runSupervisedTask gains one option invocationObserver = null. When non-null it is awaited inside the ACT step after the candidate commit (or NO_CHANGE / TOOL_UNAVAILABLE) and before any cleanup with { attemptIndex, request, timeoutMs, invocation (raw runAgentInvocation result), startedAt, endedAt, logFile, worktree, candidateBefore, candidateAfter, outcome, foldedAgentCommits }; an observer error fails the supervised run instead of being hidden. createSupervisedObservation({ tool, arm, taskId, writer }) returns { invocationObserver, eventSinks, tracer, finalize(result) }: the observer redacts and parses immediately and computes diff = `git diff --numstat candidateBefore candidateAfter` in the live worktree; eventSink/traceSink keep only { type, capability: payload.name } and { kind, name, status, durationMs }; finalize joins result.attempts[i].verification and assigns captured entries to attempt windows that open at each CAPABILITY_INVOKED / CAPABILITY span named avo.act, run-level entries (HARNESS_*, AGENT_RUN_*, STRATEGY, AGENT_RUN) going to the last attempt with scope RUN, then appends one trace per attempt in order.

D6 — Redaction: redact(text, { env }) replaces with [REDACTED] every value of an environment variable whose name matches /(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|AUTH|COOKIE|CREDENTIAL)/i and whose value length >= 8 (env = process.env merged with the invocation env), and the patterns sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}, ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}, github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}, AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}, AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35} and Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{16,}. It runs on the full captured text before excerpting (a truncated capture first drops its trailing partial line) and on argv and log excerpts; the writer re-checks the serialized line against the same secret set and refuses to write on a match (SECRET_IN_TRACE). Digests are over raw bytes (one-way).

D7 — Report: summarizeTraces(records) verifies nothing itself, groups by tool then arm (sorted) and returns traces, distinct tasks, distinct runs, status counts, exitCode counts, timeouts, verification status counts, diff totals, duration { min, median, max }, and token totals with coveredTraces/uncoveredTraces and unavailableReason counts; totals sum covered traces only. `exharness-agent report <dir>` runs readTraces (so a broken chain exits non-zero) and prints { kind: AGENT_TOOL_RUN_REPORT_V1, label: DESCRIPTIVE, groups } JSON. No acceptance, winner, value or superiority field exists.

D8 — Evidence basis: executed BB-097 CLI probe (codex --json; agy --log-file; kiro plain text in the delivered adapter), executed BB-098 observation probe over the delivered BB-097 package (supervised result omits raw output and removes logs/worktree; Core events/spans and avo.act windows), delivered Core eventSinks/createTraceRecorder, and the upstream Codex exec_events usage schema.
implementationSlices: S1 — Trace schema, writer, direct runs [OB1]: implement D1-D3. "OB1 ..." tests run runObservedInvocation with the BB-097 fake CLI on temp git repos, assert exact status/exit/timing/diff (tracked edit plus untracked file) values and sequence/prevDigest links, and assert TRACE_CHAIN_BROKEN after editing, deleting, inserting or reordering a line.

S2 — Parsers [OB2]: implement D4 with fixture outputs (a codex JSONL stream with two turn.completed usage events, one without usage, one malformed line, one truncated stream; kiro stdout; agy log file). "OB2 ..." tests assert exact token sums for codex and null-with-reason for the others, including TIMED_OUT and TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.

S3 — Supervised observation [OB3]: add the D5 invocationObserver to supervisor.js and implement createSupervisedObservation. "OB3 ..." tests run runSupervisedTask with the FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK fake and assert one trace per attempt with that attempt's verification, avo.act-window events/spans, run-level entries only on the last trace, and non-empty diff only for the CANDIDATE_CREATED attempt; direct traces carry harness null; with invocationObserver null the supervised result equals the unobserved result.

S4 — Redaction [OB4]: implement D6. "OB4 ..." tests plant an env secret and each key pattern into fake stdout, stderr, argv (kiro/agy prompt) and the agy log, including a secret split across the truncation boundary, and assert the bytes of traces.jsonl contain none of them; a record that still contains a planted secret is refused with SECRET_IN_TRACE.

S5 — Report, CLI, docs [OB5]: implement D7 and the bin `report` / `run --trace-dir`. "OB5 ..." tests assert byte-identical report output for identical traces, coverage-limited token totals, no acceptance/value/winner key anywhere, and `report` exiting non-zero on a broken chain. Write docs/living/system/agent-tools/observation.md, update state.md and the package README.

S6 — Scope [OB6]: packages/agent-tools/test/scope-audit.mjs exports the matcher and, run as a script, compares `git diff --name-only <merge-base HEAD origin/main> HEAD` with this plan's sourceScope.write/forbiddenWrite and exits non-zero on any violation or on an empty diff before merge. "OB6 ..." tests exercise the matcher only (no git history needed in CI): every write-scope path passes, and core-harness, agentic-system, benchmark, tool-adapters.js, process-runner.js, agent-tools.test.js and docs/blackboard paths are rejected.

Token usage is reported only from Codex turn.completed usage and is otherwise null with an explicit reason (Kiro, agy, timeout, unavailable, truncated or usage-free streams); malformed lines are counted.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Supervised runs yield one trace per attempt joining raw-output excerpts, diff, that attempt's verification and its ExHarness event/span window through the default-null invocationObserver plus existing eventSinks/tracer; direct traces carry harness null; an unobserved supervised run is unchanged.
No planted secret appears in any written trace byte, including secrets split by truncation, and a record still containing one is refused.
The descriptive report is deterministic, coverage-aware, verifies the chain, carries no acceptance, winner or value field, and Living docs describe observation.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Specify an append-only, digest-chained AGENT_TOOL_RUN_TRACE_V1 record per agent invocation covering tool, version, arm label, timing, exit, bounded redacted output excerpts, repository diff statistics, verification outcomes and ExHarness events/spans when supervised.
Specify per-tool output parsers that report token usage only when the tool reports it and otherwise record null with an explicit unavailable reason, never an estimate.
Specify secret redaction applied before any trace byte is written, proven by a planted-secret test.
Specify a deterministic descriptive report per tool and arm that never asserts acceptance or value, plus Living docs.

negativeVerificationCases: A codex stream without any turn.completed usage event yields null token fields with CODEX_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED, never zero.
Kiro, agy, TIMED_OUT and TOOL_UNAVAILABLE traces never carry numeric token values.
A malformed JSONL line is counted in invalidLines and does not abort parsing.
Editing, deleting, inserting or reordering any trace line makes verifyTraceFile throw TRACE_CHAIN_BROKEN.
A planted environment secret or key-pattern string, including one split at the capture truncation boundary, never appears in traces.jsonl bytes.
The report has no acceptance, winner or value field and token totals exclude uncovered traces.
A direct (unsupervised) trace has harness null; a supervised attempt trace carries only its own avo.act window plus RUN entries on the last attempt.
With invocationObserver null the supervised result and existing BB-097 tests are unchanged; an observer error fails the run instead of being swallowed.
Any write to Core, Oracle, agentic-system, benchmark, the BB-097 adapters/process runner, BB-097 tests or docs/blackboard fails the scope audit.
